definitions.supplemental: O. Sax. an-bítan: O. H. Ger. en-bízan.

quotations.old_english: Gif wulf ǽniges cynnes orf tóslíte, and hit forðon deád beo, ne onbíte (gustet) his nán Cristen man
quotations.citations: L. Ecg. P. iv. 29; Th. ii. 212, 26

quotations.old_english: Gecýðan ðæt heó ðæs forstolenan ne onbite
Ne hit se mon drincan meahte, ne his ǽnig neát onbítan ne meahte

source_text: on-bítan; p. -bát; pp. -biten (with gen.) To taste of, partake of :-- Se ðæs wæstmes onbát, Cd. Th. 30, 21; Gen. 470: 42, 22; Gen. 677. Gif wulf ǽniges cynnes orf tóslíte, and hit forðon deád beo, ne onbíte (gustet) his nán Cristen man, L. Ecg. P. iv. 29; Th. ii. 212, 26. Anbíte, iv. 28; Th. ii. 212, 23. Gecýðan ðæt heó ðæs forstolenan ne onbite, L. In. 57; Th. i. 138, 10. Ne sceal hé huniges onbítan, Lchdm. ii. 222, 20. Ne hit se mon drincan meahte, ne his ǽnig neát onbítan ne meahte, Nar. 8, 32. Nǽnigre wǽtan onbítan. Guthl. 2; Gdwin. 16, 24, [O. Sax. an-bítan: O. H. Ger. en-bízan.]
